record: issue-82 single-corner diagnosis probes (simulated, pre-layout; NOT measured)
klt: klt local backend, 1 unit per run
corner: typical / Vin 5.0 V / 27 C / iload 0.25 A (load ramps in at 260 us); bench sim/steady-state/bench.spice
tran: 2.5n 450u (saved from 20u), step_max 2.5 ns (T/200 at 2 MHz). About 860 cycles, but the loop did NOT settle in any run: steady state not established, spec 0.4 settled test not passed

runs.base: vout (abs) 1.64-1.69 V over 270-450 us; fbn 0.55-0.56 V vs vref 0.595 V; duty 0.35; unsettled
runs.nocwind (c_wind=0): same: vout 1.64-1.71 V, 3.2-3.7 % of samples outside -0.5..2.2 V, so winding capacitance is NOT the cause of the out-node spikes
runs.gnd (also saves gnd_d, vdd33, vin_d): node values below are against gnd_d unless stated; window 400-450 us
runs.lwire0p2n (l_wire 0.2 nH/wire, bench par: diagnostic only, not a spec package value

observations.error_amp_dc: refuted as cause: opamp alone, 3.3 V, ibias 10 uA, typical, 27 C, DC sweep (single ngspice -b, not committed): input offset 1.25 mV and open-loop gain ~6200 (76 dB) at Vcm=0.6 V (1.75 mV at 0.5 V). Cannot explain a ~40 mV fbn-vref error
observations.gnd_d_bounce: v(gnd_d) vs ideal 0 reaches -2.49 / +2.07 V (400-450 us), a ~1 ns ring at the SW falling edge (t=407.86 us: gnd_d -2.49 V while sw_d falls 5.7 -> 0.1 V). vdd33-gnd_d stays 3.300 V (ideal source); vin_d swings 2.52-7.08 V
observations.control_nodes_follow_ground: at that edge (absolute): vref 0.57 -> 0.26 -> 0.92 V, fbn 0.40 -> -1.65 -> +2.49 V, vc 1.41 -> -0.64 -> 3.5 V. Against gnd_d, vc stays in 0.78-2.02 V (0 % outside -0.1..3.4 V): the 'vc out of the 3.3 V rail' of #77 is a measurement against ideal 0, not a rail violation
observations.out_spikes: v(out) abs -1.16..3.72 V but out-gnd_d is 1.14..1.97 V (mean 1.653): the +/-2 V out spikes noted in #77 are the ground bounce, not Cwind/ESL
observations.clock: against gnd_d the clock runs 2.9-3.0 MHz in the baseline over 250-450 us (1.65 V crossings), 1.84 MHz with l_wire = 0.2 nH: ground bounce shifts the oscillator by ~60 %
observations.dc_error: baseline 400-450 us: fbn-gnd 0.546 V vs vref-gnd 0.583 V; vout-gnd 1.657 V vs 1.8 V target
observations.l_wire_0p2n: ground bounce 0.70 V pk (vs 2.49): vref and fbn agree (0.581 / 0.581 V in 400-450 us), clock 1.84 MHz, BUT vout-gnd swings between 0.98 and 1.66 V from one 50 us window to the next (1.11, 1.57, 0.98, 1.66 V): a second, slow, non-settled behaviour, NOT yet diagnosed

diagnosis: PARTIAL. First departing node: the die ground gnd_d, ringing +/-2.5 V for ~1 ns at each SW edge through the shared power/control ground bond wires (spec 0.3 package: 2 wires, 2 nH, 0.1 ohm each; bench Cdie 1 uF). It corrupts vref, the feedback sense, vc and the oscillator. The error amp, its 0.6 V input common mode, Cwind and the oscillator netlist alone are not the cause. Design defect (control ground not isolated, no local decoupling) versus bench artifact (die-ground model, ideal Vdd33 tied to gnd_d) is UNDECIDED. A second behaviour (slow Vout swing at low bounce) is untraced. No decision record, no bench change, no spec row changed.
not_done: other corners; 50 mA and 500 mA loads; averaged-model comparison; any fix; the slow swing at l_wire 0.2 nH
